settings.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
settings.description: Everything you need to know about Nightwooolf Auracast Bluetooth wireless audio products

settings.heading: What is Auracast Bluetooth technology?
settings.content: Auracast broadcast audio is a new Bluetooth capability that allows audio to be shared from a single transmitter to unlimited receivers without pairing. Unlike traditional Bluetooth which connects one-to-one, Auracast enables one-to-many audio broadcasting, letting you share audio with friends, family, or an unlimited audience using compatible headphones, earbuds, speakers, or hearing aids.

settings.heading: How does Auracast differ from traditional Bluetooth audio?
settings.content: Traditional Bluetooth audio creates a one-to-one connection between devices. Auracast uses Bluetooth LE Audio to broadcast audio that any number of compatible receivers can tune into, similar to how a radio station works. It offers lower latency, better audio quality with the LC3 codec, and the ability for multiple people to listen simultaneously without pairing.

settings.heading: Are Nightwooolf headphones compatible with Auracast?
settings.content: Yes! Nightwooolf products feature the latest Bluetooth LE Audio technology with Auracast support. Our wireless TV headphones and audio devices are designed to work with Auracast-enabled transmitters, TVs, and smartphones, providing you with the next-generation wireless audio experience.

settings.heading: What are the benefits of Auracast for seniors and hearing impaired?
settings.content: Auracast offers significant benefits for seniors and those with hearing difficulties: individual volume control without affecting others, enhanced dialogue clarity, low-latency audio that syncs perfectly with TV lips, and the ability to connect hearing aids directly to TV audio. It's the next generation of assistive listening technology.

settings.heading: Auracast Bluetooth Technology
What types of wireless TV headphones does Nightwooolf offer?
settings.content: Nightwooolf offers a range of wireless TV headphones designed for different needs: over-ear headphones for maximum comfort during extended viewing, in-ear neckband styles for lightweight convenience, and specialized models with enhanced voice clarity for seniors and hearing impaired users. All our products feature Bluetooth connectivity and many support Auracast broadcast technology.

settings.heading: How long is the battery life on Nightwooolf headphones?
settings.content: Most Nightwooolf wireless headphones provide 8-12 hours of continuous playback on a single charge. Many models include a charging transmitter base that doubles as a stand, keeping your headphones charged and ready. Some models also feature replaceable batteries for uninterrupted listening.

settings.heading: Are Nightwooolf headphones easy to set up for seniors?
settings.content: Absolutely! Our products are designed with simplicity in mind. Most Nightwooolf headphones feature plug-and-play setup - simply connect the transmitter to your TV's audio output, turn on the headphones, and they automatically connect. No complicated Bluetooth pairing required. We also provide clear, step-by-step instructions.

settings.heading: What is the wireless range of Nightwooolf headphones?
settings.content: Nightwooolf wireless headphones typically offer a range of 100-164 feet (30-50 meters), allowing you to move freely around your home while listening to TV. The exact range depends on the model and environmental conditions such as walls and obstacles.

settings.heading: How long does delivery take?

settings.heading: Do you ship internationally?
